parsing.notes: eCitizen login + paid. BRS is the official registrar (companies, business names, LLPs). Search + documents (CR12 directors/shareholders, status report, certified extract, annual returns) via eCitizen — paid per transaction (KES). brs.ecitizen.go.ke returned 403 to automation. No open bulk/API. Do NOT bypass the login/paywall. Field model from public knowledge; no values copied. Registration number = company id (old C./CPR, new PVT-XXXXXXX); KRA PIN join to tax. Redact directors/shareholders (Data Protection Act 2019).
